automation_sketch.code:
TRIGGER: Power Automate cloud flow - Recurrence daily 08:00 + Outlook trigger 'When a new email arrives (V3)' with Folder=Inbox, Filter=isRead eq false
ACTION 1: Get emails - Microsoft Graph mail API via Outlook connector 'Get emails' with $filter=isRead eq false and receivedDateTime ge startOfMonth(October)
ACTION 2: Filter array - Subject/From contains [invoice, bill, statement, remittance, vendor names] - keep AP candidates only
ACTION 3: Excel Online - 'List rows present in a table' on AP tracker (OneDrive/SharePoint) Table=October_AP - select Vendor, InvoiceNo, Amount, DueDate, Status
ACTION 4: Compose - Build HTML digest table: Unread AP emails (received, sender, subject, hasAttachment) LEFT JOIN October rows where Status <> Paid
ACTION 5: Create review task - 'Create a task' in Planner/To Do + send Teams/Outlook digest with deep link to October worksheet and Vendor Portal Payments URL
ACTION 6 (control): Mark processed only - Do NOT auto-mark inbox as read; set Flag or Category='AP-Review-Oct' via 'Update email' for poka-yoke
MEASURE: Log run time, count emails scanned vs AP candidates to Power BI dataset for control plan
automation_sketch.description: Daily Power Automate cloud flow that replicates steps 1-6 using official connectors: pulls unread mail via Graph, reads October worksheet via Excel Online, and creates a single review digest instead of manual window switching.

bottlenecks: Trigger in Outlook 0.34 min per item: manual open inbox, open filter, select unread (steps 1-3)
4 window switches across Outlook, File Explorer, Excel, Chrome and 8 navigation steps per item with 0% process cycle efficiency
Manual cross-check between October worksheet (steps 5-6) and Vendor Portal Payments section (step 8) with no data flow captured
quick_wins: Save Outlook unread filter as permanent view and add AP sender rule to categorize and flag payables instead of re-filtering each time
Bookmark deep link to Vendor Portal Payments section and pin October worksheet with frozen filters to skip steps 2,5,7 navigation
Move AP tracker to SharePoint/OneDrive and use Excel Table + Filter on Status=Pending/Unpaid so October review starts at first pending row

recommendations.how: Build a Power Automate cloud flow using the Outlook connector backed by Microsoft Graph mail API to list isRead eq false messages. Filter by AP keywords and sender domains, then flag with Category AP-Review-Oct instead of manually filtering. This replaces steps 1-3 with a scheduled pull and digest.
recommendations.title: Auto-collect unread payable emails via Graph mail API
recommendations.why: Theory of Constraints: fixes the recorded bottleneck at Outlook trigger 0.34 min per item and ECRS simplify before automating

recommendations.how: Store the AP tracker in SharePoint or OneDrive as an Excel Table named October_AP. Use Power Automate Excel Online or Microsoft Graph Excel API List Rows to pull pending rows automatically. recommendations.title: Centralize October tracker for API read and single review view
recommendations.why: ECRS combine: eliminates motion waste from 4 window switches by merging inbox list and tracker list into one preparation step

recommendations.how: Ask vendor or IT in writing: is there a read-only Payments API or export, how to authenticate, and can it be tested in Postman. If no API, build interim Power Automate Desktop flow that opens the bookmarked Payments URL, logs in with vaulted credentials, exports Payments status to CSV, then stops for human review. Replace RPA with API once available.
recommendations.title: Pull Payments status via vendor API, RPA only as interim
recommendations.why: Prefer official APIs over screen automation; Vendor Portal API status is unknown so do not assume it exists, use poka-yoke export instead of visual cross-check

recommendations.how: Change process to one daily October payables digest: unread AP emails plus pending October rows plus portal Payments export in one table with Vendor, Invoice, Amount, Status. Reviewer works top-down in that list and updates Status in Excel only. Measure time per review and mismatch rate weekly.
recommendations.title: Combine inbox, tracker and portal into one daily review list
recommendations.why: ECRS combine and rearrange plus control plan: removes repeated navigation and makes errors impossible to miss by forcing single source for review

risks: Vendor Portal RPA will break on UI, URL, or MFA change and needs credential vaulting; API access may be denied
Auto-filter may miss payables or include non-AP unread mail if keywords are wrong; do not auto-mark as read
Excel file lock or concurrent edits if tracker stays as local File Explorer file instead of SharePoint version with Table structure
Privacy and over-sharing risk if invoice emails are copied to Power BI or Teams without access controls

tasks.name: Process vendor invoice for payment
tasks.summary: Processes a vendor invoice received by email for payment. Invoice details are extracted from the PDF into the AP tracker, then re-entered in the vendor portal with supporting documentation attached, and the source email is archived.
inputs: Vendor invoice email with PDF attachment
outputs: Updated AP tracker with invoice details
Submitted vendor payment request with attached invoice
Processed invoice email moved to Processed folder
decision_points: Determine the correct due date to record for the invoice
Determine the appropriate GL code for the invoice
reasons: 32 values copied by hand from one application to another

assumptions: AP Tracker.xlsx is stored in OneDrive/SharePoint so Microsoft Graph Excel API can read/write it; local-only file would need migration first
Vendor Portal has no confirmed API (status unknown) - advice assumes no API until vendor/IT confirms docs, auth, and attach/submit endpoints
Invoice PDFs contain selectable text; scanned images will need OCR via Azure Document Intelligence
Due date in column D (10 chars typed) and GL code in column E (4 chars typed) are derivable by rule/lookup - source logic not visible in recording and must be confirmed with AP owner
No separate approval step is required beyond portal Submit; if approval is needed it stays manual
Outlook mail permissions (Mail.ReadWrite) and a Processed folder can be granted to the automation identity
Vendor names and invoice-number formats in portal match the PDF exactly; no fuzzy matching or vendor onboarding needed

automation_sketch.code:
import os, requests, msal
TENANT=os.getenv('TENANT_ID'); CLIENT=os.getenv('CLIENT_ID'); SECRET=os.getenv('CLIENT_SECRET')
DI_ENDPOINT=os.getenv('DI_ENDPOINT'); DI_KEY=os.getenv('DI_KEY')
SITE_ID=os.getenv('SITE_ID'); DRIVE_ID=os.getenv('DRIVE_ID'); FILE_ID=os.getenv('AP_TRACKER_FILE_ID')
# 1. auth to Microsoft Graph
app=msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(CLIENT, authority=f'https://login.microsoftonline.com/{TENANT}', client_credential=SECRET)
tok=app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])['access_token']
gh={'Authorization': f'Bearer {tok}'}
# 2. find unread vendor invoice emails with PDF
msgs=requests.get('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/mailFolders/inbox/messages?$filter=isRead eq false&$top=10&$expand=attachments', headers=gh).json().get('value',[])
for m in msgs:
    pdfs=[a for a in m.get('attachments',[]) if a.get('name','').lower().endswith('.pdf')]
    if not pdfs: continue
    att_id=pdfs[0]['id']; msg_id=m['id']
    pdf_bytes=requests.get(f'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/messages/{msg_id}/attachments/{att_id}/$value', headers=gh).content
    # 3. Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt-invoice
    url=f'{DI_ENDPOINT}/formrecognizer/documentModels/prebuilt-invoice:analyze?api-version=2023-07-31'
    h={'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': DI_KEY, 'Content-Type':'application/pdf'}
    op=requests.post(url, headers=h, data=pdf_bytes).headers['Operation-Location']
    import time; res=None
    for _ in range(20):
        time.sleep(2); res=requests.get(op, headers={'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': DI_KEY}).json()
        if res.get('status') in ('succeeded','failed'): break
    doc=res['analyzeResult']['documents'][0]['fields']
    inv_no=doc.get('InvoiceId',{}).get('valueString','')
    vendor=doc.get('VendorName',{}).get('valueString','')
    total=doc.get('InvoiceTotal',{}).get('valueCurrency',{}).get('amount')
    due=doc.get('DueDate',{}).get('valueDate','')  # needs human rule if missing
    conf=min([doc.get('InvoiceId',{}).get('confidence',0), doc.get('VendorName',{}).get('confidence',0)])
    if conf<0.85 or not total:
        print(f'HOLD {inv_no} low confidence -> route to human'); continue
    payload={'invoice_number':inv_no,'vendor':vendor,'amount':total,'due_date':due}  # single capture for Excel+Portal
    print(payload)  # 4. write to Excel via Graph + submit to portal via Playwright/API in next stage
    # Example Excel append (table): requests.post(f'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/drives/{DRIVE_ID}/items/{FILE_ID}/workbook/tables/APTable/rows/add', headers={**gh,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, json={'values':[[inv_no,vendor,total,due,'']]} )
    # 5. archive email
    requests.post(f'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/messages/{msg_id}/move', headers={**gh,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, json={'destinationId':'Processed'})
automation_sketch.description: Top recommendation: poll Outlook via Graph, extract invoice fields via Azure Document Intelligence invoice model, create single payload for Excel and Vendor Portal, write to Excel via Graph and archive email. Low-confidence items route to human review.

bottlenecks: Write in Chrome Vendor Portal 0.8 min/item (steps 13-21) - manual new request, 4 fields re-typed, file dialog navigation and Submit
Extract from Acrobat Reader (steps 3-9) - scroll to find total due, copy 3 fields by hand; Run 4 needed 2 extra steps to scroll/zoom to read details
10 window switches + 6 navigation steps per item and double-handling: Excel column C copied in (step 9) then copied out to portal (step 15)
Unresolved typed inputs block flow: Due date column D (step 10) and GL code column E (step 11) typed by hand with unknown rules, plus re-typed Vendor/Invoice/Due date in portal (steps 14,16,17)
quick_wins: Enable Excel Data Validation on Due date (date only) and GL code (4-char list/dropdown) to enforce poka-yoke before automation

recommendations.how: Trigger Power Automate cloud flow on Outlook inbox arrival with PDF attachment via Microsoft Graph mail API. Send PDF to Azure Document Intelligence invoice model to return InvoiceId, VendorName, InvoiceTotal, DueDate with confidence. If confidence >0.85 auto-append row to AP Tracker.xlsx via Microsoft Graph Excel API; if low, route to human review in Teams/Outlook. Archive source email to Processed via Graph move.
recommendations.title: Capture invoice once with AI extraction and auto-write AP tracker
recommendations.why: ECRS eliminate + automate: removes 24 Acrobat Reader->Excel hand copies, scrolling to find total, and 369 typed chars. Evidence: transportation waste 4 values/item, 76% time moving/re-typing, cycle efficiency 11%.

recommendations.how: Ask vendor/IT for Vendor Portal API docs, auth, and test in Postman: endpoints for create payment, attach file, submit. If no API, use Power Automate Desktop or Playwright script that reads the single payload (invoice number, vendor, amount, due date) plus downloaded PDF and fills New Payment Request, attaches file, submits once with duplicate-submit guard. Reuse Excel row as audit record, not as copy source.
recommendations.title: Submit Vendor Portal payment from single payload - API first, browser automation fallback
recommendations.why: Theory of Constraints - fix the bottleneck (0.8 min/item portal write). Also poka-yoke: eliminates 3 proven re-typed duplicates and double Submit seen in run 6, plus 8 Excel->Portal hand pastes.

recommendations.how: Change rule: capture each value once into automation memory/table then write to both Excel and portal in same step. Keep Excel only as system record written by automation, not as intermediate copy-paste. Batch validate all 8 invoices first, then submit; exceptions go to a person queue.
recommendations.title: Eliminate Excel as in-between copy file
recommendations.why: ECRS eliminate and combine: evidence shows 1 value (Total due -> column C -> Amount) copied in only to be copied out, and Vendor/Invoice/Due date exist elsewhere. Reduces motion waste (10 switches/item).

recommendations.how: Interview AP owner to document rules for Due date (e.g., Net 30 from invoice date?) and GL code (vendor-to-GL map?). Replace free typing in steps 10-11 with Excel VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP table or Power Automate lookup, plus dropdowns. Make portal Due date and GL fields pull from same lookup. Measure error rate in Power BI before/after.
recommendations.title: Turn Due date and GL code typing into rules and dropdowns
recommendations.why: ECRS simplify + poka-yoke: open questions show both values typed by hand (10 chars and 4 chars) with unknown origin; free typing causes defects and blocks straight-through automation.

risks: Vendor Portal has no documented API - browser automation breaks on portal UI change and needs selector maintenance and login/MFA handling
AI misread of Total due, vendor, or invoice number causes wrong payment; requires confidence threshold, human review queue, and duplicate-invoice check before Submit
GL code and Due date rules unknown - automating wrong assumption creates systematic mis-coding and late/early payments

TRIGGER: Recurrence - Every Friday 15:00 UTC (Weekly AP summary)

ACTION 2: Compose - Build Subject: concat('Weekly AP Summary - WE ', utcNow('yyyy-MM-dd'))
ACTION 3: Compose - Build HTML Body with outputs from Script (Total Due, Overdue, Paid, Top vendors) + link to file
ACTION 4: Outlook - Send an email (V2)
  - To: ap-manager@[domain] (from fixed contact)
  - Subject: outputs Subject
  - Body: outputs HTML Body
  - Attachment: Link to SharePoint file (not duplicate .xlsx attachment)
